tools.name: register_assumption
tools.description: Add one line to the ledger the user reads when your turn ends. Call it as it happens, one item per call, when you: assume something you did not check (kind 'assumption'); choose between real alternatives (kind 'decision'); or consider a better or more complete fix and decide not to do it now (kind 'considered-not-done'), the one that matters most. Skip the obvious. Keep text to one sentence.
